{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gungenineeren''' was a corp of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] that specialized in operating underwater. They were typically responsible for the development and maintenance of the [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubbles]] and the organic [[Bubble wort/Legends|bubble wort]] Gungan cities were constructed from. They could also perform various other tasks as the situation called for it.

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Occupation of Theed]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a small corp headed by [[Koh Pa Wupps]] was assigned by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] to salvage a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] from the bottom of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. During the recovery, an escort of three [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble bongos]], piloted by members of the [[Naboo Resistance]], protected the group from a young, orphaned [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]] that attacked the site repeatedly.

The MTT, [[Transport 714]], was used to convey [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her forces undetected to to a hidden passage at the base of [[Theed/Legends|Theed's]] cliff, where they [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|infiltrated and eventually reclaimed the city]].
